requirements.title: Advancing input/output positions after the last record read or written absent error
requirements.definition: An advancing input/output statement always positions a record file after the last record read or written unless an error condition occurs.

pending.advancing-io-error-exception: No portable oracle asserts a post-error position; future tests inducing errors must not depend on a subsequent position without first repositioning.

requirements.oracle:
Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive plans establish a non-default state first (for example by writing known records, initializing variables to nonzero/nonblank sentinels, or creating a known file) and then observe only portable properties: exact internal records, successful IOSTAT zero, nonzero IOSTAT for a specified error condition, or named intrinsic status values where the standard names them. Processor-dependent unit numbers, file names, record lengths, storage-unit encodings, buffering, timing, IOMSG text, and specific error numbers are not asserted.

S12.3.4.2-001 I/O positioning/internal runtime fixtures: valid run-phase fixtures cover `advancing-io-positions-after-last-record`. These fixtures are finite single-image positive runtime observations over scratch or local external files and character internal files. They assert only exact integers, logical inequalities, exact characters with LEN checks, IOSTAT zero, IOSTAT_END/EOR named constants, IOLENGTH=/POS=/SIZE= values or inequalities derived from the executing processor, and FILE_STORAGE_SIZE positivity. They do not assert physical byte encodings, record-marker layout, IOMSG text, processor-specific numeric error statuses, unsupported deferred-length internal WRITE behavior, or diagnostics for unnumbered restrictions.

requirements.title: Nonadvancing input/output may leave a record file within the current or a subsequent record
requirements.definition: A nonadvancing input/output statement may position a record file at a character position within the current record or a subsequent record, and nonadvancing input/output can read or write a record by a sequence of data transfer statements each accessing part of the record.

pending.nonadvancing-may-position-subsequent-rec: Pending after batch284 review: no distinct fixture with its own facet-specific assertion and feature mutation is shipped in this packet.

requirements.title: Incomplete nonadvancing output is completed as corresponding advancing output before close or repositioning
requirements.definition: If a nonadvancing output statement leaves a file positioned within a current record and no further output statement for that file precedes close, BACKSPACE, ENDFILE, or REWIND, the effect is as if it were the corresponding advancing output statement.
